description: This header file defines the `absl::FunctionRef` type, a lightweight, non-owning reference wrapper for invocable objects with a specific signature. It provides mechanisms to construct from various invokable types, including function pointers and functors, and emphasizes usage as an argument type to avoid ownership and lifetime issues.

classes.name: absl::FunctionRef<R(Args...)>
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning reference wrapper for any invokable object with a compatible signature, intended for use as an argument type to avoid ownership and lifetime issues.

methods.name: FunctionRef(const F& f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from any invokable type, ensuring compatibility with the signature.

methods.name: FunctionRef(F* f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from a function pointer, avoiding indirection.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped invokable object with provided arguments.
